arche's parser was fixed on 2026-11-23 before this preregistration: a last part ending in State/Region/County/Province is now the region (found on the synthetic set, which is therefore not independent); the fixed parser is pinned below

question: On real NG, KE and GH addresses, which parser splits an address into its parts best: arche's, arche's after fixing all-caps/all-lower input, or libpostal (Senzing v1.2)?

arms.arche_cased: same parser; input with no lower-case or no upper-case letters re-cased word by word first (each run of letters capitalised); mixed case unchanged
arms.libpostal: G0a's libpostal arm (Senzing v1.2 parser model); measured only, never a label source

rule.comparisons: paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 0, unit address) of arche_cased - arche, libpostal - arche, libpostal - arche_cased, per country and pooled
rule.decision: per country: arche_cased replaces arche if arche_cased - arche has a 95% interval above 0; then libpostal becomes the default if libpostal - (best arche arm) is above 0, the arche arm stays default if below 0, otherwise no difference and the arche arm stays
rule.interpretation: NG/KE/GH default parser chosen per country by the decision rule
rule.match: G0a's: equal after casefold and removing non-alphanumerics; empty gold must be empty; plus a trailing 'state', 'region' or 'county' dropped from state on both sides
rule.population: the blind pack (build_g0b_pack.py, seed 20261123): 250 address cells from four published health-insurance provider lists, NG Clearline 100, KE CIC 60, KE Jubilee Nafuu 40, GH Equity 50; labelled by one person following LABELLING.md; rows marked skip dropped
rule.primary: parse_correct (all seven fields match), per country and pooled, with Wilson intervals
secondary: landmark column (not scored): how often each arm puts landmark text into road/suburb/city
synthetic sanity set (300 sanov NG/GH addresses x as-is/upper/lower)
